formal.admission_only_change: If all numeric EPS entries, state and row inputs stay fixed, only a certification flag/rule change produces zero numerical delta in F_a and the computed tail/lapse; acceptance and custody may change.
formal.field: F_a = sum_i e_i B_i^(a), where e_i is max EPS among certificate intervals overlapping state shell i
formal.gate_margin: Existing SRB-ROT compares RBound_j <= tau_j/10; adapter contract tau_j=0.25 sigma_j, so modelled budget=0.025 sigma_j, conditional on the numerical bound assumptions. This is not an independently established total-error guarantee.
formal.one_interval_delta: For aligned unit shell s, Delta F_a = Delta e_s B_s^(a); for multiple overlapping state cells, sum Delta e_i B_i^(a).
formal.relative_sensitivity: For e_s>0, F_a>0, e_s_new=m e_s: F_a_new/F_a=1+(m-1) alpha_s^(a), alpha=e_s B_s^(a)/F_a in [0,1]. No upper bound on alpha from e_s/eps_max alone.
formal.row_bound: RBound_j = beta_j F_1, beta_j = max_{k in row j} R_k c^2/(2 N_min v_k * 1000), fixed state and positive valid rows
formal.true_error_limit: Finite sample/refinement/search records do not provide an upper bound on the unsampled supremum. The measured refinement increment is not a worst-case error bound. A rigorous finite worst case needs an independent enclosure/regularity bound; a numerical km/s sensitivity also needs the actual state B and row factors, not available in certification-only inputs.

no_rule_change: No final A295 constants inferred or implemented; build remains standby.
scope: TESTED saved certification-record arithmetic; FORMAL symbolic sensitivity; actual state/rows and true supremum UNTESTED
